Finishing his talk before answering a Bedouin, the Prophet said to await the Hour when honesty is lost, which happens when authority passes to unfit people.
Among the signs of the Hour: religious knowledge decreases, ignorance, drinking and open illegal sexual intercourse spread, and women so outnumber men that fifty depend on one man.
Knowledge will be taken away, ignorance and afflictions will appear and harj, which the Prophet showed by gesture to mean killing, will increase.
The Hour will not come until knowledge is taken away, earthquakes become frequent, time passes quickly, afflictions and killing increase and wealth overflows.
Before the Hour Muslims will fight the Jews until a stone tells of a Jew hiding behind it, and fight the Turks, small-eyed and flat-nosed, and people in hair shoes.
At Tabuk the Prophet names six signs before the Hour: his death, Jerusalem's conquest, a plague, overflowing wealth, an affliction in every Arab house, and Byzantine betrayal after a truce.
The Hour will not be established until a man from Qahtan appears, driving the people with his stick.
Before the Hour Muslims will fight the Turks and others with small eyes, red flat-nosed faces like shields and hairy shoes; the best people hate ruling until chosen for it.
The Hour will not come until two groups with one claim fight with great casualties, and about thirty liars appear, each claiming to be Allah's messenger.
The Hour will not come till the sun rises from the west; then all will believe, but faith will not benefit a soul that did not believe before.
Pointing with his index and middle fingers, the Prophet says his advent and the Hour are like these two fingers.
Among the portents of the Hour: religious knowledge taken away, ignorance, illegal sexual intercourse and drinking widespread, and women so outnumbering men that one man looks after fifty.
Holding up two fingers, the Prophet said his advent and the Hour are as close as these.
The Prophet said time will pass quickly, good deeds will decrease, miserliness will be cast into hearts, and Harj, meaning killing, will increase.
The Hour is as close to the Prophet's sending as two fingers; it comes after the sun rises in the west, so suddenly that bargains and meals go unfinished.
Among the Hour's signs: religious knowledge taken away, ignorance spreading, drinking and open illegal intercourse common, and women so many that fifty have one man to look after them.
The Hour will not come until two great groups fight each other while making one and the same claim.
Near the Hour time will pass quickly, good deeds decrease, miserliness spread, religious knowledge vanish, ignorance and afflictions appear, and killing (al-Harj) abound.
Near the Hour, religious knowledge will be taken away, ignorance will spread and killing (al-Harj) will abound, and the most wicked people will be living when it comes.
Before the Hour come Daus women circling their idol, a fire from Hijaz, gold uncovered by the Euphrates, alms finding no taker, and the sun rising from the West.
